description: Void a payroll that has not moved any money: a draft, or a scheduled direct deposit whose bank debit has not started. Two steps. First call it with payroll_id only: nothing is voided, and you get the payroll (employees, pay period, gross, pay date) and a confirmation_code that works for 10 minutes. Show the user that payroll and ask them to confirm. Only after they say yes, call it again with the same payroll_id, the confirmation_code and a short reason. A payroll with money already on the move (approved, processing, funded or paid) or a completed one is refused with code payroll_not_voidable_via_api and an app_url: give the user that link to void it in the NannyKeeper app, and do not retry. If the code is refused (confirmation_expired, confirmation_invalid, payroll_changed), start again from the first step and confirm with the user again. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

confirmation_code.description: Leave it out on the first call. Then pass the code the first call returned, only after the user confirmed.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

payroll_id.description: The payroll id from get_payroll, list_payrolls or run_payroll.

reason.description: Required with confirmation_code: why the payroll is being voided, in a few words (for example 'Wrong hours').

name: void_payroll
